description: This Java class 'GLWorld' manages 3D shape and vertex data for OpenGL rendering, including buffer generation, vertex addition, transformation, and drawing routines, indicating it's part of a graphics rendering module.

classes.name: GLWorld
classes.description: Manages a collection of 3D shapes and vertices for OpenGL rendering, handling buffer creation, shape addition, vertex transformations, and rendering.

methods.name: addShape
methods.description: Adds a shape to the world and updates the total index count.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Prepares buffers for vertices, colors, and indices for rendering.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Creates and adds a vertex to the vertex list at given coordinates.

methods.name: transformVertex
methods.description: Updates a vertex position via a transformation matrix.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the shapes and vertices with OpenGL.

methods.name: toFloat
methods.description: Converts an integer to a float value, normalizing with 65536.0f.
